subject: mean-centred product terms to study interaction effects can't be computed

messages.author: 4f373f746900e389
messages.subject: mean-centred product terms to study interaction effects can't be computed
parts:
Hi all,

I wan to model the moderating effects of age and gender on the relationship between my latent variables.

I am trying to compute the interaction terms using this code:

prod = DataQuestionnaireStudy1809.csv$PE1 * DataQuestionnaireStudy1809.csv$AGE
DataQuestionnaireStudy1809.csv$prod1 = prod - mean(prod)
prod = DataQuestionnaireStudy1809.csv$PE2 * DataQuestionnaireStudy1809.csv$AGE
DataQuestionnaireStudy1809.csv$prod2 = prod - mean(prod)   

However, as shown by the function head(name_of_data) all product terms are defined as NA.

Does anyone have an idea what I am doing wrong?

Thanks and kind regards

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: mean-centred product terms to study interaction effects can't be computed
parts:
My guess is that is because there is at least 1 NA in the data, you have to tell to the mean function to ignore NAs, otherwise will show a mean = NA

mean(prod, na.rm=T)
